verdict.rationale: PagerDuty documents automations that run without a human in the loop. Incident Workflows trigger automatically on conditions such as all P1/P2 incidents, using if-this-then-that logic. Event Orchestration automatically deduplicates or suppresses alerts. The Shift Agent coordinates schedule changes without manual intervention, and the SRE Agent handles incidents and fixes. Missing for 10: independent or hands-on corroboration that these automations run autonomously in practice, and documented time-based recurring schedules (the evidenced automations are event-triggered, not cron-style jobs).

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can set up automations that run autonomously in the background

citations.quote: Incident Workflows allow you to build an automated response for every incident. For example, you can configure one workflow that automatically triggers for all P1 and P2 incidents
Through highly-configurable triggers and actions, you can apply "if-this-then-that" logic to orchestrate the right response for your teams, processes, and business.
Event Orchestration: Automatically deduplicate or suppress alerts.
monitors calendars, detects potential conflicts, identifies qualified replacements, and coordinates schedule changes without manual intervention
SRE Agent handles incidents and fixes. You step in when it matters.
